g.text: Four variants × three sizes. Properties: Label (text), Icon (boolean). One Primary per view; Destructive only inside confirmations and manage screens.
Badges label state (read-only). Chips are toggleable filters — the game-type picker. Tags are mono stamps for matchup direction (vs / @).
Checkbox for independent options, radio for one-of-many in a list, switch for settings that apply immediately, segmented control for 2–4 peer views (league).
Games are marked free by default so they don't block your availability.
Adds the game's ESPN page to the event's URL field.
Domain atoms reused by the preview, schedule list and manage screens. TeamMark is a slot for the ESPN logo — swap the fill for the image.
36px fields on the card surface with a hairline. Focus swaps the border to ring and adds a 3px ring-halo; errors swap to destructive and pair with helper text.
Overlays sit on card with a strong border and the only shadow in the system. Items are 32px, 4px radius, highlighted with accent. Destructive items go last, after a separator.
